versions.changelog:
**Expanded CCPA/CPRA audit coverage and updated documentation.**

- Coverage increased from 20 to 24 compliance items, including new checks for HR data, security risk assessments, proxy agents, and user interface symmetry.
- Compliance item list and mapping updated in the documentation to reflect new and revised requirements.
- Instructions for API Key file handling clarified and simplified.
- Security and data handling details expanded, including note on anonymous trial identifier storage.
- Removed the skill summary card file (skill-card.md).

- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No functional or feature changes; documentation and core functionality remain the same.

ccpa-audit 2.0.2

- Removed the skill-card.md file from the project.
- No feature or logic changes; this is a documentation cleanup only.
- All audit functionality and usage remain unchanged.

- Adds support for anonymous cloud-scored trial runs: up to 5 free audits (in 7 days) without requiring an API Key.
- Automatically handles anonymous trial via anon_id if no Key is provided, and refers users to one-click Key registration as needed.
- No other functional or content changes.
- Removes the redundant skill-card.md file.

**Web-based API key registration replaces all local account collection/handling.**

- Removed all code and instructions for collecting or transmitting email/password within the skill.
- API Key must now be obtained manually from the compliancehub.cn web account center, then supplied via environment variable or config file.
- Skill no longer creates or writes the API key file automatically; only consumes existing keys.
- Security section and usage instructions updated to clarify no credentials are handled locally.
- Removed the skill card markdown file.

ccpa-audit 1.1.0

- Added concise usage tips (in Chinese) for answering and progressing through the audit.
- Clarified that draft answers are auto-saved during the audit and users can resume or restart if interrupted.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No changes to check content, scoring, or cloud connectivity.

- Clarified explicit opt-in requirements: The skill now only activates when the user clearly requests to run the ccpa-audit skill by name; generic CCPA mentions will not trigger it.
- Strengthened privacy controls: Preview mode (--non-interactive) fetches check items from the cloud but never sends answers; if offline, it uses a bundled ruleset.
- Made account and credential handling opt-in: No account is created or credentials stored unless you explicitly run --login; no persistence by default.
- Updated usage and agent instructions to reflect stricter triggers and improved privacy notes.
- Removed file: skill-card.md.

- Added requirements.txt to specify dependencies.
- Added _user_meta.json for user metadata management.
- Removed skill-card.md.
- Updated skill description to clarify bilingual (中文/English) operation—now defaults to Chinese guidance with English legal terms; users can request English output at any time.

- Removed the file: skill-card.md
- No functional or behavioral changes to the skill itself
- Documentation and audit item coverage remain the same

- Removed the file skill-card.md.

- Documentation and usage remain the same.

- Improved documentation on account provisioning and security: now clarifies that the `--login`/`--auth` command collects your email and password only for official compliancehub.cn authentication endpoints.
- Updated SKILL.md to explicitly describe how and where credentials are transmitted and used during API key registration.
- No functional or code logic changes; this release focuses on enhancing transparency and data handling documentation.

Initial release of the ccpa-audit skill.

- Provides a free CCPA & CPRA compliance audit with 20 core items.
- Cloud-based scoring via the CQDev engine at compliancehub.cn (requires free API Key).
- Includes an offline preview mode (--non-interactive) that does not transmit data.
- Free to install; cloud scoring uses a points quota (100 free calls).
- Secure data handling with clear endpoint disclosure and no shell execution.
- Full usage instructions and guidance for report generation and key handling.
